entradas.text: I arrived home from work, hung my jacket up, and put my briefcase in the hall.
"Darling, what's wrong?"
entradas.menu: "Darling, what's wrong?"

entradas.text: "Who is it from?"
entradas.menu: "Who is it from?"

entradas.text: I sat down on the couch next to Monica.
entradas.menu: Sit down next to Monica.

entradas.text: "It's from the Department of Education. Franc's university exam results are in."
"How did he do?"
entradas.menu: "How did he do?"

entradas.text: "Why are you so worried, then?"
entradas.menu: "Why are you so worried, then?"

entradas.text: "He failed, didn't he?"
entradas.menu: "He failed, didn't he?"

entradas.text: "Just read the letter."
I looked at the page. Below Franc's name and address, his score was written: 435 points, out of a total of 1000.
At the bottom of the letter, the word "Failed" was stamped in red.
"All those years of effort, all those private lessons... all down the drain."
"Maybe it'll be good for him to learn from his mistakes."
entradas.menu: "Maybe it'll be good for him to learn from his mistakes."

entradas.text: "Does he know the results yet?"
entradas.menu: "Does he know the results yet?"

entradas.text: "He brought this upon himself."
entradas.menu: "He brought this upon himself."

entradas.text: "This isn't just about Franc, you know. Him failing will reflect badly on you. On us."
"No, but he should be back from school soon."
"I just don't understand. Franc's a smart boy -- why would he sabotage himself like this?"
I heard a key turning in the front door. Franc stomped in and was about to go straight upstairs when he noticed us both in the living room.
I waited for Monica to start the conversation.
entradas.menu: Wait for Monica to start the conversation.

entradas.text: "Have a seat, Franc."
entradas.menu: "Have a seat, Franc."

entradas.text: He took a seat across from us, and I handed him the letter. He started reading it.
"Your exam results arrived today."
Franc sat down, and Monica handed him the letter. He started reading it.
"Oh, shit."
"I... I need a moment."
He went to the kitchen sink and washed his face. A moment later, he came back.
"I never thought this would happen. I'm so sorry."
"It's my fault. I should have been around to help you study."
entradas.menu: "It's my fault. I should have been around to help you study."

entradas.text: "How could you let us down like this?"
entradas.menu: "How could you let us down like this?"

entradas.text: "You made your mother cry with your actions."
entradas.menu: "You made your mother cry with your actions."

entradas.text: "It's not the end of the world."
entradas.menu: "It's not the end of the world."

entradas.text: "Pretty close, though, isn't it?"
"I know, I know, I can't do anything right!"
"So it seems."
entradas.menu: "So it seems."

entradas.text: "Not so fast. There might be something I can do."
entradas.menu: "Not so fast. There might be something I can do."

entradas.text: "Anton. Isn't there *anything* you can do?"
"If Alphonso could get his dimwit son into Kingshill University, I'm sure Holsord State would have room for a bright boy like Franc."
"I'm going upstairs after him."
"Leave him be. He needs time."
entradas.menu: "Leave him be. He needs time."

entradas.text: I said nothing.
entradas.menu: Say nothing.

entradas.text: "Suit yourself."
entradas.menu: "Suit yourself."

entradas.text: Monica went upstairs after Franc and I started reading documents before dinner.
"I suppose I need some time as well."
Monica left the living room and I started reading newspapers before dinner.
Monica went upstairs after Franc and I started reading documents before dinner.
"With enough money, I could get you into Harcard in Arcasia. It's one of the best universities in the world."
entradas.menu: "With enough money, I could get you into Harcard in Arcasia. It's one of the best universities in the world."

entradas.text: "That sounds... great, actually!"
"Anton! I want him to stay in Sordland."
"Mom. I've got to get out and experience the world sometime. And in Arcasia, people might see me as something more than just the president's son."
"I still don't like it, but I understand."
"United People's University in United Contana is free. It also has an excellent medical program."
entradas.menu: "United People's University in United Contana is free. It also has an excellent medical program."

entradas.text: "Communism, I can dig that."
"Not exactly how I was expecting to spend my student years, but anything's better than the military."
"This is the future of our boy, Anton. What should we do?"
"It's been decided. You're going to United Contana, Franc."
entradas.menu: "It's been decided. You're going to United Contana, Franc."

entradas.text: "He must have made us proud."
entradas.menu: "He must have made us proud."

entradas.text: "See for yourself."

Gone were the days when I could expect a warm welcome from my family. Franc was either at school, barricaded in his room or out with friends. Deana spent more and more time at her after-school art classes, and Monica... well, Monica avoided me at all costs.

I awaited my usual welcome from Deana before realizing she was out at one of her art classes. Franc was still at school, and Monica... it had been a long time since she'd come to the door to greet me.
I paused, awaiting my usual greeting from my wife and daughter. Deana was out at one of her after-school art classes, I remembered. But where was Monica?
From the living room, I heard a muffled sob.
I entered to find Monica sitting on the sofa, a letter in her hands and a look of despair on her face.
Monica briefly rested her head on my shoulder, then handed me the letter.
Monica pointedly moved a few inches away from me, then handed me the letter.
"You know what this means -- he's going to have to join the military. He could die, Anton!"
"He did this to get back at you, you know. Maybe if you had been there for him more often..."
"Hi, Mom. What's going on?"
"Mom? Dad? What's going on?"
"Franc! Language!"
entradas.menu: "Franc! Language!"

entradas.text: "That's all you have to say?"
entradas.menu: "That's all you have to say?"

entradas.text: "Son, we're not angry at you..."
entradas.menu: "Son, we're not angry at you..."

entradas.text: "You're a disappointment to this family, Franc."
entradas.menu: "You're a disappointment to this family, Franc."

entradas.text: "Do you think I give a fuck?"
Monica gasped.
"Right, you should've taken a break from running the country to help your loser son!"
Franc looked close to tears. Monica put her hand on his shoulder.
"It's all about you, isn't it? You don't care that I bombed the test. You just care how it makes you look!"
"How dare you speak to your parents that way!"
entradas.menu: "How dare you speak to your parents that way!"

entradas.text: "My image doesn't matter. This is your future we're talking about."
entradas.menu: "My image doesn't matter. This is your future we're talking about."

entradas.text: "You're right. The President of Sordland cannot have a failure for a son!"
entradas.menu: "You're right. The President of Sordland cannot have a failure for a son!"

entradas.text: Monica put her hand on his shoulder. She glared at me.
Monica put her hand on his shoulder.
"I know it's been a rough time. But you really should have studied harder, Franc."
"I know."
Franc's face crumpled.
"It's going to be okay. But you really should have studied harder, Franc."
"Yes!"
"I'm not going to take life lessons from Ewald Alphonso."
entradas.menu: "I'm not going to take life lessons from Ewald Alphonso."

entradas.text: "I am a respected alumnus, it's true."
entradas.menu: "I am a respected alumnus, it's true."

entradas.text: "I do have connections to the board."
entradas.menu: "I do have connections to the board."

entradas.text: "It would be nice to have him closer to home."
entradas.menu: "It would be nice to have him closer to home."

entradas.text: "I guess it's the army for me, then..."
"So, what am I supposed to do now?"
"Well, there's always military school. But you're the president's son. You still have options."
entradas.menu: "Well, there's always military school. But you're the president's son. You still have options."

entradas.text: "You'll go to military school, of course. It's the only place that will have you."
entradas.menu: "You'll go to military school, of course. It's the only place that will have you."

entradas.text: Monica surprised me with her enthusiasm.
"But I failed the exam. This sucks. Are you sure about all of this. Isn't it technically illegal?"
"If you're going to abuse your power to get me into a school, I want it to be as far away from this family as possible."
"Wait. You could also study abroad..."
entradas.menu: "Wait. You could also study abroad..."

entradas.text: "It's true, you could study abroad..."
entradas.menu: "It's true, you could study abroad..."

entradas.text: "No. I won't influence your life. You've got to live with what you've done."
entradas.menu: "No. I won't influence your life. You've got to live with what you've done."

entradas.text: "Really? President Anton Rayne suddenly refuses to influence his family members' lives? After banning his wife from politics?"
"That's beside the point. You were the one who caused that whole deal in the first place."
entradas.menu: "That's beside the point. You were the one who caused that whole deal in the first place."

entradas.text: "Come on, Anton. This is the least you can do after what you did to me!"
"There was more at play there than just you or me or any of us. I have a duty to this nation."
entradas.menu: "There was more at play there than just you or me or any of us. I have a duty to this nation."

entradas.text: "I'm so sorry that duty required you to publicly ridicule me!"
"Don't change the subject from Franc to you."
entradas.menu: "Don't change the subject from Franc to you."

entradas.text: "Mom! Dad! Stop fighting!"
"I don't want to cause any more trouble than I already have. I'll go to military school."
"I don't want to cause any more trouble than I already have. I'll join the army."
"I'm sick of this house and I'm sick of both of you. I'll go to military school."
"I'm sick of this house and I'm sick of both of you. I'll join the goddamn army."
"I understand principles are important. But, Anton, which is more important? Your principles or your son's future?"
Franc ran upstairs to his room.
"Franc, wait--"
entradas.menu: "Franc, wait--"

entradas.text: "Good. It's time you learned some discipline."
entradas.menu: "Good. It's time you learned some discipline."

entradas.text: "My principles, of course."
entradas.menu: "My principles, of course."

entradas.text: "My son's future, of course."
entradas.menu: "My son's future, of course."

entradas.text: "Then I believe you will make the right choice."
"I knew it."
"If it's so important to you, I'll join the goddamn army. I won't be around to disgrace you any further."
"If it's so important to you, I'll go to goddamn military school. I won't be around to disgrace you any further."
"No, I've made my decision. You're going to military school, Franc."
entradas.menu: "No, I've made my decision. You're going to military school."

entradas.text: "No, I've made my decision. You're joining the army, Franc."
entradas.menu: "No, I've made my decision. You're joining the army."

entradas.text: "Fine. Let me think about this."
entradas.menu: "Fine. Let me think about this."

entradas.text: "Thank you, Anton."
"Great. See you when I come home in a body bag."
"All right, Dad. Serves me right for not studying."
"There's Holsord State, or you could study abroad..."
entradas.menu: "There's Holsord State, or you could study abroad..."

entradas.text: "You know how I feel about communists, but United People's University in Contana is free. It also has an excellent medical program."
entradas.menu: "You know how I feel about communists, but United People's University in Contana is free. It also has an excellent medical program."

entradas.text: "Holsord State University is the right decision after all."
entradas.menu: "Holsord State University is the right decision after all. [Nepotism]"

entradas.text: "I won't influence your life, Franc. The military is the right choice."
entradas.menu: "I won't influence your life, Franc. The military is the right choice."

entradas.text: "What do you think, Anton?"
"There's also Harcard in Arcasia. It's one of the best universities in the world. With enough money, I could get you in."
entradas.menu: "There's also Harcard in Arcasia. It's one of the best universities in the world. With enough money, I could get you in."

entradas.text: "On second thought, I'd rather send Franc to Harcard in Arcasia."
entradas.menu: "On second thought, I'd rather send Franc to Harcard in Arcasia." [-2 Personal Wealth]

entradas.text: "It's been decided. I'll pay for Franc to go to Harcard."
entradas.menu: "It's been decided. I'll pay for Franc to go to Harcard." [-2 Personal Wealth]

entradas.text: "On the other hand, United People's University in United Contana is free and has an excellent medical program..."
entradas.menu: "On the other hand, United People's University in United Contana is free and has an excellent medical program..."

entradas.text: "On second thought, I'd rather send Franc to United Contana."
entradas.menu: "On second thought, I'd rather send Franc to United Contana."

entradas.text: "The better to keep me under your thumb at all times."
"Thanks so much, Dad. I swear I won't let you down this time."
"But fine, I accept. It's better than the army."
Monica let out a long exhale.
"What a day! Who's hungry for dinner?"
Monica disappeared to the kitchen; Franc to his room. I went to my office and began making some phone calls.
"I don't care. Whichever gets me out of here the fastest!"
"Thanks, Dad. Holsord State still would have been my first choice."
"Not only yours."
"But it's your call to make, after the way I messed up."
"Holsord State University is the right decision after all. It will cost a little extra due to the privatization changes."
entradas.menu: "Holsord State University is the right decision after all. It will cost a little extra due to the privatization changes." [-1 Personal Wealth], [Nepotism]

entradas.text: "No. I won't influence your life. You've got to live with what you've done."
entradas.menu: "No. I won't influence your life. You've got to live with what you've done."

entradas.text: "Terrific. Holsord State it is, then."
entradas.menu: "Terrific. Holsord State it is, then. [Nepotism]"

entradas.text: "Terrific. Holsord State it is, then. Though, It going to cost us a little bit extra due to the privatization changes."
entradas.menu: "Terrific. Holsord State it is, then. Though, It is going to cost us a little bit extra due to the privatization changes. [-1 Personal Wealth], [Nepotism]"

entradas.text: "Unfortunately, Holsord is a no go. We don't have the money, right now."
entradas.menu: "Unfortunately, Holsord is a no go. We don't have the money, right now."

entradas.text: "All thanks to you and your privatization changes!"
"You could also study abroad..."
entradas.menu: "You could also study abroad..."

entradas.text: "So, I guess, you've got to live with what you've done."
entradas.menu: "No. I won't influence your life. You've got to live with what you've done."

entradas.text: "No, I've made my decision. I'm sending you to Holsord State."
entradas.menu: "No, I've made my decision. I'm sending you to Holsord State. [Nepotism]"

entradas.text: "You could also study abroad..."
entradas.menu: "You could also study abroad..."

entradas.text: "You're right. Besides, We don't have the money for Holsord, right now."
entradas.menu: "You're right. Besides, We don't have the money for Holsord, right now."

entradas.text: "No, I've made my decision. I'm sending you to Holsord State, even if it is going to cost us a little bit extra due to the privatization changes."

"Wow, you're the best dad, ever!"
Franc sneered at my statement.
Franc sneered at my statement.
"Wow, you're the best dad, ever!"
"Actually... never mind."

entradas.text: "This is the future of our boy, Anton. What should we do?"
"Holsord State would be amazing! A bunch of my friends are going there, I could still come home to do my laundry."
"There's nothing for us to decide. Franc's going into the military."
